name: Exclusion stacks, rotated across queries
when: a productive query is dominated by a few prolific authors, venues or a homonym
shape: <query> -author:<A> -author:<B> … or -source:<S> …; budget ≤10 -author: or ≤8 -source: per query and rotate the exclusion set across follow-ups instead of cramming
ingredients: the dominating authors/venues from the last page
yields: the second tier of the same query — works the prolific few had pushed off the page
misses: exclusions do not count toward the 32-word cap but long stacks still narrow the page; a homonym shared by the wanted works
origin: gs_revamp query-craft doctrine memo (2026-07); exclusions cap-exempt by live probe
